summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Search Bar and WhatsApp Button features completed. All 14 test cases passed successfully. Search functionality works with real-time filtering, debounce, text highlighting, and add-to-cart/buy-now actions. WhatsApp button is correctly positioned, styled, and hidden on admin pages.

issues: Some product images show 'imgbb.com image not found' placeholder - external image hosting issue, not code bug

passed_tests: Search Icon: Magnifying glass icon visible in navbar header on desktop and mobile
Search Bar Open: Click search icon opens search input bar with placeholder 'Search jewelry, shringar, dresses...' and close button
Search Real-time Filter: Typing 'Kundan' shows 4 matching products with 200ms debounce working correctly
Search Highlight: Matching text highlighted with pink/rose background (bg-[#E8A0A8]/30) in product names, categories, and descriptions
Search No Results: Typing 'xyznonexistent' shows 'No products found' with 'Try a different search term' message
Search Close X Button: Clicking X button closes search bar and clears results
Search Close Escape: Pressing Escape key closes search bar
Search Add to Cart: Clicking cart icon in search results adds product to cart (cart count increases from 0 to 1)
Search Buy Now: Clicking Buy Now (zap) icon navigates to /checkout page with product in order summary (₹2799)
WhatsApp Button Visible: Green floating button visible at bottom-right corner on homepage
WhatsApp Button Color: Correct green color #25D366 (rgb(37, 211, 102))
WhatsApp Hidden on Admin: WhatsApp button NOT present on /firebase-admin/login page
Categories Page: Both search icon and WhatsApp button present and functional on /categories
Mobile Responsive: Search bar and WhatsApp button work correctly on 375px mobile viewport
critical_code_review_comments: Code implementation is clean and follows React best practices
Debounce implemented correctly with useRef for cleanup
ConditionalWhatsApp component properly hides button on admin routes
Search overlay has proper z-index (60) to appear above other content
Text highlighting uses mark element with appropriate styling
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing products from Firestore (Kundan rajasthani aad, Royal kundan aad, Kundan aad, Kundan Kangan, Royal Sirpech, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Search and WhatsApp features fully functional. Search loads products from Firestore on first open, then filters client-side. Products exist in Firestore with categories like JEWELRY, TRADITIONAL, RADHA KRISHNA ITEMS. WhatsApp button uses pulse animation (animate-ping) and scale-on-hover (group-hover:scale-110). Some product images show imgbb placeholder due to external hosting issues.
